svg.text: GPU context events align with stretched kernel spans
RTX 5090 · BF16 · D512 · S1024 · dense · native CUDA graphs · no telemetry collectors
Raw kernel intervals stay intact. Shading marks SAVE_END → next RESTORE_START; no latency subtraction.
